title: Record ID
description: Names one record across the store.

title: Title
description: A record's name in a few words.

title: Statement
description: A rule or requirement in full.

title: Position
description: A record's place among its siblings.

title: Path
description: Which path through a flow a step is on, such as main or refused.

title: Identifier
description: A name code uses: a kind's, a field's, a relation's or a setting's.

title: Subdomain type
description: How much modeling a domain deserves.

title: Entity role
description: Whether an entity is its aggregate's root or a part.

title: Basic type
description: A field's type when it is no value object and no reference.

title: Table storage
description: How a table is stored.

title: Key type
description: What a table key is.

title: Endpoint method
description: How an endpoint is called.

title: Event delivery
description: How an event type reaches what hears it.

title: Run by
description: How a test runs: its level, its state, and the file that runs it or why it is manual. Fields: Level, State, File (optional), Manual reason (optional).

title: Kind field type
description: The type of a product kind's field.

title: Stage
description: Where a kind is read and colored.

title: Relation role
description: Whether a relation designs, builds or proves.

title: Group name
description: A short heading a long list of requirements or rules is sorted under.

title: Check name
description: The name of a check, which its problems carry.

title: Check severity
description: What a check's problems are. An error means the data is broken; a warning means work is still to do.

title: Children limit
description: The most children of one kind a record should hold.

title: Key binding
description: A chord such as Mod+Shift+P, or chords separated by spaces for a sequence. "Mod" is Cmd on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.

title: Token values
description: A map from token names in the app's token table to values.

title: Theme file
description: A theme as data, as it is stored, exported and imported.

title: Window bounds
description: Where a window was and how big.

title: Window chrome
description: The two colors a page sends for its window.

title: App address
description: A place in the app: a path and its stage query parameter.

title: Page stage
description: What a page or a place shows on its stage.

title: Session settings
description: How the graph is laid out, whether its minimap shows and its Map draws all its links, and how wide the wiki card is, one for the browser session and shared by every place (LA-EXP-A6).

title: Entities limit
description: The most entities an aggregate should hold.

title: Place view
description: How a place shows its focus, apart from its stage: its depth, kind filters and wiki card. Each place's own, kept per tab (LA-EXP-A5).
